content: {"like":["Enjoys well-crafted, suspenseful crime dramas with strong investigative leads.","Prefers films with vivid 3D effects and immersive visuals.","Values engaging, well-structured action sequences and choreography.","Appreciates clear, logical plot progression and coherent storytelling.","Likes high-quality sound design that enhances the viewing experience."],"dislike":["Dislikes half-baked murder plots that rely on perfect execution.","Finds muddled dialogue and abrupt plot changes frustrating.","Criticizes overused detective tropes and cliché characters.","Rejects poor picture quality, dropouts, and continuity errors.","Dislikes unnecessary or irrelevant content that distracts from the main story."]}
